src:
MOV     AH, 3Ch          ; DOS: create TEST.TXT
XOR     CX, CX           ; CX = 0: normal attributes
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK            ; stop if CF = 1
MOV     BX, AX           ; BX = the handle
MOV     AH, 40h          ; write ten digits
MOV     CX, 10
MOV     DX, OFFSET DIGITS
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     AX, 4202h        ; DOS: seek, AL = 2: from the end
XOR     CX, CX           ; CX:DX = 0
XOR     DX, DX
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     SI, AX           ; DX:AX = the size (DX = 0 here)
MOV     DX, OFFSET M1
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AX, SI
CALL    PDEC
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AX, 4200h        ; AL = 0: from the start, CX:DX = 3
XOR     CX, CX
MOV     DX, 3
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     DX, OFFSET M2
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
CALL    READ2            ; read 2 bytes and print them
MOV     AX, 4201h        ; AL = 1: from here, offset 0
XOR     CX, CX
XOR     DX, DX
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     SI, AX           ; where the pointer is now
MOV     DX, OFFSET M3
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AX, SI
CALL    PDEC
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AX, 4202h        ; AL = 2, CX:DX = -2
MOV     CX, 0FFFFh
MOV     DX, 0FFFEh
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     DX, OFFSET M4
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
CALL    READ2
MOV     AH, 3Eh          ; close the handle
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 41h          ; delete TEST.TXT
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h

FNAME   DB      "TEST.TXT", 0
DIGITS  DB      "0123456789"
M1      DB      "size: $"
M2      DB      "at 3: $"
M3      DB      "now at: $"
M4      DB      "end - 2: $"
READ2   PROC    NEAR     ; read 2 bytes from BX, print them and CR LF
MOV     AH, 3Fh
MOV     CX, 2
MOV     DX, OFFSET BUF
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     CX, AX           ; DX still = OFFSET BUF
CALL    OUT1
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
RET
READ2   ENDP
CRLF    DB      13, 10, "$"
BUF     DB      64 DUP (?)
CHECK   PROC    NEAR     ; CF = 1: print the error code in AL and exit
JNC     CHECK1
PUSH    AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET FAILMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
CALL    PHEXB
MOV     AX, 4C01h        ; exit with code 1
INT     21h
CHECK1:
RET
CHECK   ENDP
FAILMSG DB      "failed: error $"
PHEXB   PROC    NEAR     ; print AL as two hex digits
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     DH, AL           ; keep the byte
MOV     CL, 4
SHR     AL, CL           ; the high digit first
MOV     CX, 2
PHEXB1:
AND     AL, 0Fh
ADD     AL, "0"
CMP     AL, "9"
JBE     PHEXB2
ADD     AL, 7            ; 10..15 -> "A".."F"
PHEXB2:
MOV     DL, AL
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AL, DH           ; then the low digit
LOOP    PHEXB1
POP     DX
POP     CX
RET
PHEXB   ENDP
PDEC    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX in decimal
PUSH    BX
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     BX, 10
XOR     CX, CX           ; CX = digits pushed
PDEC1:
XOR     DX, DX
DIV     BX               ; AX = AX / 10, DX = the last digit
PUSH    DX
INC     CX
OR      AX, AX
JNZ     PDEC1
PDEC2:
POP     DX               ; the digits come back first to last
ADD     DL, "0"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PDEC2
POP     DX
POP     CX
POP     BX
RET
PDEC    ENDP
OUT1    PROC    NEAR     ; write CX bytes at DS:DX to handle 1
PUSH    BX
MOV     BX, 1            ; standard output
MOV     AH, 40h
INT     21h
POP     BX
RET
OUT1    ENDP
